newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Trump Hotels cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Trump Hotels cut.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said Wednesday analyst Bruce Turner downgraded Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc to underperform from hold.
-- Cited Trump Hotels second quarter results, which at a loss of $0.14 per share, "were sharply below our estimate of a gain of $0.03 per share."
-- Changed 1997 estimate to a loss of $1.05 per share from a loss of $0.85.
-- Changed 1998 estimate to a loss of $1.00 per share from a loss of $1.00.
-- Set 1999 estimate at a loss of $0.70 per share.
-- "We believe that Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts will not yield any significant shareholder appreciation in the near future," Turner said in a research note.
